description: PB-85 is the dedicated registration code for the Kalanaur Sub-Divisional Transport Office in the Gurdaspur district of Punjab. This office operates as a Sub-RTO, providing essential services such as the issuance of driving licenses, vehicle registration (RC), and road tax collection for the local sub-division.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Kalanaur, District Gurdaspur, Punjab
